name: Kurusu Kokoro
source:
A childhood friend who is devoted to the protagonist.

A bright and kind childhood friend who lives next door. She likes [url=/c62808]Yuu[/url], but can't really tell him. Furthermore, Yuu has become a woman, making it even more difficult for her to talk about it. A pitiable girl whose efforts are often in vain. Her suffering continues...
